messages:
Maria S (Sales): Hey team — FinEdge (POC next week) asked for a minimal assurance pack before execs sign off: SOC 2/ISO PDFs, pen-test attestation, and a brief note on whether Dedicated changes pricing. Can we confirm what we can hand them and who signs the pen-test letter? Deal doc: https://redwood.sales/DEAL-5789 :folded_hands:

Kevin L (Solutions): +1. I can own collection. Minimal checklist I usually send: ```- SOC2 Type II report (pdf, dates)
- ISO27001 cert (scope + pdf)
- Pen-test attestation (signed letter)
- High-level network diagram (staging only)
- Staging IP window & presigned upload instructions
- KMS/key custody excerpt (short)```

Rachel P (Security): We have a standard pen-test attestation template. Need to confirm signatory (Legal vs Security Officer). Redaction for sensitive bits (IPs/creds) is fine. @Dave R can you advise preferred signatory?

Dave R (Legal): Fine for us to sign as 'Redwood Inference, Inc. — Security Officer'. We just need the recipient name / TO line from the customer and confirmation they accept our template. I can prepare the doc once recipient specified. Template link: https://redwood.internal/templates/pen-test-attestation.docx

Andrew O (Infra Ops): Note on Dedicated: requires static egress IPs and VPC peering (or private link) which is a config + infra uplift. Ballpark uplift for a small dedicated pool is ~+$7.2k/month and a one-time setup of ~$4k. If they stay on hosted, no infra change. Also need to schedule a 24h external scan window — prefer Wed/Thu next week. @Kevin L is that workable?

Kevin L (Solutions): I will create a presigned upload and dataroom entry today. Will also ask FinEdge for a PO confirmation if they want Dedicated isolation (so we can lock pricing).

AuditBot: SOC2 artifacts available in Assurance Dataroom: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/DEAL-5789 (read-only link created by @Maria S)

Maria S (Sales): Thanks. Two asks for reply to FinEdge by EOD: 1) Confirm pen-test signatory and template OK, 2) Confirm scan window + dedicated uplift estimate. I'll update the customer with the timeline.

Rachel P (Security): Confirming: pen-test signer OK as 'Security Officer' via Legal sign-off. Template acceptable. I can turn around the signed attestation within 48 hours after we finalize recipient TO line.

Dave R (Legal): I'll prep and sign within 48 hours after recipient confirmed.

Andrew O (Infra Ops): Scan window: Wed-Thu next week works (we'll need 09:00-17:00 UTC). Final dedicated uplift: $7,200/mo for a 2-GPU small pool; one-time setup $4,000. If they opt hosted, we proceed with presigned uploads only.

Maria S (Sales): Perfect — I'll tell FinEdge: pen-test attestation in ~48h once recipient confirmed, staging scan Wed-Thu, Dedicated uplift ~$7.2k/mo + $4k setup if chosen. Asking them to confirm recipient name for the letter and whether they want Dedicated. Tagging @Kevin L to start dataroom/presign.

Kevin L (Solutions): On it — I'll post the presign link + a short README with the checklist and upload instructions, will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
